description: This file defines an abstract class `Smarty_Resource_Recompiled` for Smarty template resource plugins that handle recompiled templates without cache compilation. It includes methods for processing templates, populating compiled file paths, and disabling timestamp checks.

classes.name: Smarty_Resource_Recompiled
classes.description: Abstract class for Smarty resource plugin handling recompiled templates without cache compilation.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Compiles a template from source and prepares the compiled object.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Sets the compiled file path and timestamp to false, indicating a recompiled resource.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Returns false to disable timestamp checks for recompiled resources.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the template for recompiled resource.

methods.name: populateCompiledFilepath
methods.description: Populates the compiled resource with filepath info, here setting it to false.

methods.name: checkTimestamps
methods.description: Indicates timestamp checks are disabled, always returns false.
